purpose: Factual project knowledge, decisions, assumptions and evidence index

sources.locator: User Xbox mode/trigger and simulation requirements, 2026-10-21

revisions.statement: ESP32-S3 firmware compilation succeeds. PlatformIO reports 31724 bytes static RAM and 588761 bytes program flash. No hardware execution, pairing or flight was performed.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: The hardware ESP32-S3 target compiles with 31732 bytes static RAM and 588741 bytes program flash after the full estimator reset fix. No physical execution is claimed.
revisions.reason: Rebuilt after fc_init reset and C organization changes; prior size evidence is retained.

revisions.statement: ESP32-S3 hardware target compiles with 31836 bytes static RAM and 590573 bytes reported program flash. This includes queued raw HID/UART and separate BLE/peripheral tasks; no physical execution.
revisions.reason: New code and original successful compiler output.

revisions.statement: Main retains RP2350/RP2040. This branch uses an ESP32-S3 on the drone and an Xbox Series X/S controller.

revisions.statement: Use the esp32-s3-devkitc-1 target from the original Drone PlatformIO project; exact physical board/wiring still needs checking.

revisions.statement: Use XboxSeriesXControllerESP32_asukiaaa 1.1.3 and NimBLE 2.5.1, with a guarded raw-report observer on the downloaded library.

revisions.statement: Parse complete reports in the callback; synchronize the pilot snapshot and preserve actual receive time. Do not poll the mutable parser state across cores.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: BLE callback queues raw 16-byte Xbox reports and actual receive timestamps. The C control task owns decoding, hold timers and authority; companion frames also carry receive timestamps across the queue.
revisions.reason: Move all input/authority logic into the single C runtime.

revisions.statement: Mode 2: left horizontal yaw rate; left vertical speed with centered height hold; right roll/pitch angles; RT boost. LT and other buttons reserved.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: Mode 2 sticks retained. RT boosts climb/collective allowance; LT reduces it. Down+A 5s selects stable, Down+B 5s navigation; Down+LT >=90% 2s latches disarm.
revisions.reason: Latest explicit user control mapping supersedes reserved LT/buttons.

revisions.statement: LB+RB+A/B logs one-shot takeoff/landing requests. No mission or physical arming action is connected.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: 39-check QEMU replay verifies full five-second mode holds, report-gap restart, once-per-hold action, two-second LT disarm/latch, malformed HID and UART validation. Old LB/RB takeoff/land logging was replaced.
revisions.reason: Executed current raw-report C path on the emulated ESP32-S3.

revisions.statement: Six C controller objects: roll/pitch outer-angle P and inner-rate PI, yaw-rate PI, altitude PID. All gains remain provisional.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: Flight math/calibration in one C file; minimal C++ adapter required by existing Arduino/Xbox/sensor APIs.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: A 2000 us timer requests control work. dt is measured and missed/late cycles reported. Actual deadlines have not been measured.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: 2 ms timer requests the C control task on core 0. On core 1, sensor/UART/NVS service and lower-priority BLE reconnection use separate tasks so a blocking BLE library call need not postpone pressure/UART service. Physical timing remains unmeasured.
revisions.reason: Separate slow work by blocking behavior; preserve measured dt and disabled outputs.

revisions.statement: 250 ms maximum report age is provisional. Idle report behavior and actual loss/range/latency need bench measurements.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: Pilot expires after 250 ms; a report gap >100 ms restarts gesture holds. Navigation companion expires after 150 ms and requests neutral angle/rate/vertical command while pilot remains fresh. Thresholds require physical latency/report-rate measurements.
revisions.reason: Add bounded companion authority without changing the requested motor-disarm policy.

revisions.statement: Keep physical arming disabled. Motor pins remain inputs; no servo/ESC output driver is included.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: Warn at 35 percent estimated charge; latch disarm at 20 percent regardless of height. Do not automatically land.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: No actual pack voltage/current acquisition or OCV/capacity characterization. An Xbox controller's reported battery level is not aircraft SOC.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: MPU6050 at 0x68, 8g/500dps, 42Hz DLPF, nominal 500Hz sampling; data-ready and complete burst checks. Mount transform remains unverified identity.

revisions.statement: BMP280 factory compensation with 100-reading session ground reference; pressure-age checking. Actual correlated noise and delay remain unmeasured.

revisions.statement: Original Drone sketch used direct RT throttle, five PID objects, 50Hz ESC servo output, fixed dt and a Boolean tick flag; it was reviewed, not flown.

revisions.statement: Prior native Gazebo/ROS and other engine recordings are retained as historical evidence. No ESP32-specific feedback simulation or flight is claimed.

revisions.statement: QEMU now executes the active ESP32-S3 C core with synthetic input replay. An ESP32/Gazebo closed-loop flight connection and new flight recording remain pending. Prior engine recordings retain their historical scope.
revisions.reason: Separate completed CPU replay from the still-pending feedback flight simulation.

revisions.statement: Native Gazebo 10.5/OGRE2 is connected to the active ESP32 C host DLL at a logical 500 Hz. Five manual flights passed using raw simulated Xbox reports only. Navigation world verification is recorded separately; this is not QEMU-in-Gazebo or physical flight.
revisions.reason: Close the flight plant loop and preserve original engine evidence.

revisions.statement: Final native Gazebo set passed 5/5 raw-Xbox manual flights and 10/10 distinct navigation layouts with no native panel contacts. Mean endpoint errors are 0.094864 m manual and 0.015281 m navigation. Active C host core, synthetic sensors/assumptions and simulated local odometry only; earlier failures retained.
revisions.reason: Completed original native trials and independent file/CRC/video consistency audit.

revisions.statement: Workstation simulation first; companion hardware not selected. ROS2 C++/camera/YOLO/localization and physical transport remain future integration on this branch.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: Portable ROS2 C++ drone role accepts PC start/finish requests only in Xbox-selected navigation mode, then runs mission phases/A* from RGB YOLO/PnP observations. Host simulations use Gazebo local odometry. Pi/Jetson, VIO and electrical UART remain unvalidated.
revisions.reason: Companion runtime now exists on this branch; hardware choice remains open.

revisions.statement: Isaac Sim was removed at the user's request; do not add it as an active requirement. TensorFlow is not a project requirement.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: 25 Isaac Sim Python packages were uninstalled. Residual Isaac data/staging folders and historical Isaac project files remain because direct deletion was blocked by automatic command policy. Shared vision Python and TensorFlow/CUDA settings were retained.
revisions.reason: Correct the earlier blanket removal claim using actual package-manager logs and the removal blocker.

revisions.statement: Prior tracked content is archived coherently; old launch scripts assume the original root layout. Main remains the runnable reference for that workflow.
revisions.reason: Migrated without changing the original claim from schema 1.

revisions.statement: Active firmware, emulation, documentation and knowledge are indexed in a code map. Editor settings hide the historical RP2350 tree and caches by default. Original evidence stays versioned; generated SQLite moved to ignored build/knowledge.
revisions.reason: Keep durable evidence and facts separate from regenerable tool/search caches.

revisions.statement: The duplicate RP2350 snapshot is stored locally at .cache/archive/rp2350 with a versioned SHA-256 inventory and immutable Git recovery reference. Active source remains in the main branch. Tools are grouped by purpose, emulation is under simulation/emulation, and both worktrees have a root command catalog.
revisions.reason: User requested project-wide architecture and cache cleanup. Original evidence is preserved.

revisions.statement: Espressif QEMU ESP32-S3 executed 4982 logical 2 ms steps and passed 19 checks on the active C core. Inputs are synthetic; no BLE, sensor-register, ESC, NVS-persistence or real-time timing proof.
revisions.reason: Added for the requested emulation, organization and linear model work.

revisions.statement: Active C source passes all 39 named checks on Espressif QEMU ESP32-S3. Synthetic fixed sensors, gesture timeline and UART protocol only; no flight physics, physical BLE/I2C/UART/ESC or real-time guarantee.
revisions.reason: Latest retained replay supersedes the 19-check baseline; baseline failures remain.

revisions.statement: Espressif QEMU ESP32-S3 passes 44 named checks on the active C source, including standalone companion disable/navigation rejection/capability bits. Synthetic inputs; no flight plant or physical timing proof.
revisions.reason: Live Xbox / optional companion and selectable-route setup. Original evidence and previous revisions retained.

revisions.statement: fc_init resets angle/bias and height/velocity estimator state and covariance defaults; a reinitialization check passes in the QEMU replay.
revisions.reason: Added for the requested emulation, organization and linear model work.

revisions.statement: A 16-state, four-input F450 hover LTI plant includes 450 mm nominal diagonal, 159.099 mm roll/pitch lever, motor lag and translational drag. Physical parameters are assumed; numerical continuous and exact held-input plant matrices are generated.
revisions.reason: Added for the requested emulation, organization and linear model work.

revisions.statement: For the documented assumed plant and ideal state feedback, rounded C gains give stable continuous and 2 ms sampled loops. Largest sampled pole magnitudes: roll/pitch 0.994932, yaw 0.993840, height 0.998631. This excludes actual delay, estimator dynamics and saturation.
revisions.reason: Added for the requested emulation, organization and linear model work.

revisions.statement: Schema 2 stores stable facts, append-only dated revisions, typed sources, evidence levels and dependency relations. SQLite FTS5 is a disposable cache; validation, hash freshness, build locking and atomic replacement protect integrity. Nine isolated failure-containment/search checks pass.
revisions.reason: Added for the requested emulation, organization and linear model work.

revisions.statement: Version-1 UART uses QN 28-byte bounded/CRC/sequence-checked setpoints and QS 16-byte FC mode/freshness/disarm telemetry. ROS2 UART bridge supports Windows/POSIX but has no hardware transport proof.
revisions.reason: Define one binary boundary for hardware and simulator.

revisions.statement: Known-size blue panel PnP uses synchronized RGB/pose and rejects map centre height outside 0.90 +/-0.20 m on the controlled flat-floor fixtures. This rejects observed occlusion ghosts but is not arbitrary-object monocular depth.
revisions.reason: A parking-scene failure exposed false distances from partial silhouettes.

revisions.statement: PC browser map sends local-map endpoints through the real ROS2 mission service. HTTP map/pose routes and external-origin rejection passed; frontend JS syntax checked. No interactive browser click or separate-machine deployment is claimed.
revisions.reason: Provide a user-facing ground-PC tool without direct FC/motor inputs.

revisions.statement: PC map receives live pose, planned path and observed panel estimates. Additional operator-mode Gazebo flight accepted a custom endpoint/cruise height through HTTP -> actual ROS2 mission service; the virtual Xbox sent zero automatic mission requests. It landed/disarmed successfully. Browser clicking and separate-machine hardware remain untested.
revisions.reason: Completed original native trials and independent file/CRC/video consistency audit.

revisions.statement: PC map offers two or three points via mission/route. Both native Gazebo regressions pass through actual Cyclone DDS; three-point middle error 0.02964 m at 1.24831 m height, final error 0.01165 m, zero panel-contact steps. These route flights use simulated Xbox gestures; hardware precision and arbitrary obstacle avoidance are unvalidated.
revisions.reason: Live Xbox / optional companion and selectable-route setup. Original evidence and previous revisions retained.

revisions.statement: Reviewed PC route editor accepts 2 to 64 nodes, with first=start and last=finish, node editing/reordering, JSON save/load and explicit approval. Browser-approved five-node mission visited all intermediate nodes and landed before subsequent manual collision. Bounds errors now name the invalid node; explicit scene reset can place the vehicle at the first node.
revisions.reason: User-reported UI/input/navigation failure, manual sensitivity correction and 15 fps analysis request. Original failures retained.

revisions.statement: Actual Windows XInput reports reach live native Gazebo through the active C host core. Standalone launch loads no ROS2; optional companion launch uses rmw_cyclonedds_cpp and YOLO/PnP. Native cameras and PC map are localhost tools. Startup checks establish input/transport, not completed human flight or ESP32 BLE.
revisions.reason: User requested live real Xbox and optional companion architecture.

revisions.statement: Actual Xbox stick input produced native Gazebo flight. Initial joint-mode gesture was absent, so mode-selection buttons now explicitly emit labelled PC simulator gestures through the C parser. The browser displays native follow/overview/onboard cameras and readiness. A later manual collision is retained, not counted as a successful session.
revisions.reason: User-reported UI/input/navigation failure, manual sensitivity correction and 15 fps analysis request. Original failures retained.

revisions.statement: FC_ENABLE_COMPANION=0 builds an ESP32-S3 standalone target, disables Serial2 activity, rejects QN commands and Down+B navigation, and advertises capability off in QS byte 7 bit 0. Physical arming remains disabled. Runtime capability checks pass in QEMU; both hardware targets compile.
revisions.reason: User requested live real Xbox and optional companion architecture.

revisions.statement: Gentle simulation input uses squared sticks after deadband, 5-degree roll/pitch limits, 0.5m/s vertical and 45deg/s yaw requests, and reduced triggers. Normal remains available; full Down-LT disarm is preserved. This is not horizontal speed/position hold. Physical firmware gains and limits are unchanged.
revisions.reason: User-requested control, software and evidence improvements.

revisions.statement: ROS2 uses intended path velocity for yaw and holds heading near waypoints/landing. Same five-node before/after simulated cases passed; yaw travel decreased 57.03% and yaw-rate RMS 39.53%. This single-case comparison does not characterize hardware or all layouts. A separate 15fps five-node run passed.
revisions.reason: User-requested control, software and evidence improvements.

revisions.statement: New native cameras/video target 15fps and telemetry is retained at 500Hz; earlier 5fps/50Hz files remain intact. The analysis tool scans every native frame, enables frame stepping, exports graph means/min/max and evaluates navigation separately from later manual collisions. Off-origin reset and a ROS-free 15fps recording were verified.
revisions.reason: User-requested control, software and evidence improvements.
